stories.title: Mulinge: Sustainability cannot be left to a department Prosper
stories.excerpt: Sylvia Mulinge, the chief executive officer of MTN Uganda. PHOTO/MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI
stories.summary: In 2025, mobile money transaction value rose from Shs158.6 trillion to Shs195.5 trillion, while loans disbursed increased from Shs1.5 trillion to Shs2.7 trillion. KPMG’s True Value Assessment estimated that from 2022 to 2024, MTN created Shs34.9 trillion in value above reported profits: Shs17.1 trillion in economic value and Shs17.8 trillion in social value. Like every business investment, it must be disciplined and demonstrate value.
